description: This file defines a class 'Image_Graph_Dataset_VectorFunction' that extends a dataset class and generates points for a vector function based on sine and cosine functions, with methods for calculating points and maxima, and handling data points. It is part of the Image_Graph package, representing a specialized dataset for graph plotting.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Dataset_VectorFunction
classes.description: A dataset class that generates points based on parametric vector functions using external functions for X and Y, such as sine and cosine, within specified bounds.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Dataset_VectorFunction
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the vector function dataset with bounds, functions for X and Y, and number of points, then calculates maximum and minimum values.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Method intended to add a point to the dataset but is currently empty.

methods.name: _getPointX
methods.description: Returns the X coordinate for a given parameter x by applying the specified X function.

methods.name: _getPointY
methods.description: Returns the Y coordinate for a given parameter x by applying the specified Y function.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the internal position to the minimum T value for iteration.

methods.name: _stepX
methods.description: Calculates and returns the interval between two adjacent T values based on the total range and number of points.

methods.name: _calculateMaxima
methods.description: Iterates over the range of T values, computes X and Y via functions, and updates extrema properties.
